By accessing or using Team Riley's services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

2. Services Description

Team Riley provides web design, development, and maintenance services for health and wellness businesses. Our services include:

  • Custom website design and development
  • Website hosting and maintenance
  • Unlimited updates and modifications
  • SEO optimization and performance improvements
  • Technical support and consulting

3. Subscription Plans

Our services are offered on a subscription basis with three tiers:

  • Silver Plan: $199/month + $500 setup fee (1-5 pages)
  • Gold Plan: $399/month + $500 setup fee (5-15 pages)
  • Platinum Plan: $599/month + $500 setup fee (15+ pages)

All plans include unlimited updates. Subscriptions are billed monthly and can be cancelled at any time.

4. Payment Terms

  • Setup fee and first month's subscription are due at project initiation
  • Monthly subscriptions are billed on the 1st of each month
  • Payments are non-refundable

5. Cancellation Policy

You may cancel your subscription at any time with no penalties. Upon cancellation, your website will remain live until the end of your current billing period. You will receive all website files and retain full ownership of your content.
